title: Deduplicate Transactions
description: The POS bridge sometimes retries a ticket and the lake ends up with duplicate txn_ids. Keep one row per txn_id — the latest by event_ts (tie-break store_id asc). Use a window row_number; dropDuplicates alone is not enough. Output: txn_id, store_id, product_id, quantity, event_ts. Write Parquet with overwrite. Run uses smoke testcases; Submit row-diffs against expected/.

problemStatement.overview: Keep one row per txn_id (latest event_ts); write Parquet to OUTPUT_PATH.
symptoms: Duplicate txn_ids inflate counts and revenue.
Retries land as near-identical rows with later event_ts.
yourTaskSteps: row_number over partition txn_id ordered by event_ts desc, store_id asc; keep rn=1.
Write txn_id, store_id, product_id, quantity, event_ts to OUTPUT_PATH.
Submit is graded with a row-level compare against each selected testcase expected/.
problemStatement.yourTask: Implement src/main.py that deduplicates transactions by latest event_ts.
hints: dropDuplicates(["txn_id"]) does not guarantee latest — do not rely on it alone.

gradeChecks: Spark job succeeds on selected Submit testcases
OUTPUT_PATH has one row per txn_id (latest event_ts)
Each Submit testcase expected/ matches candidate rows
